units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 29:3">Kel. XXIX, 3</cite> <he>ח׳ משקולת</he> chord of the plumb-line; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 29:4">ib. 4</cite> <he>ח׳ מאזנים</he> of the balances.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 121b">Yeb. 121ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ח׳ השערה</he> a single hair, v. <cite ref="D00989"><he>דִּקְדֵּק</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite>, a fr. <he>ח׳ השדרה</he> the spinal chord.—
<cite ref="Chagigah 12b:8">Ḥag. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>הקב״ה … ח׳ של חסד</he> the Lord strings around him a chord of grace (protection).
<cite ref="Megillah 13a:12">Meg. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ של חסד וכ׳</he> a chord of (divine) grace was strung &c.
<cite ref="Menachot 39a:3">Men. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>נפסק הח׳ מעיקרו</he> the twining thread of the show-fringes is broken at the top.

<cite ref="Menachot 39a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ של כרך</he> the thread used for twining; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᵇ bot. <he>חוטמה וכ׳</he>, read: <he>חוט דומה לשערה</he> a band (of hair) resembling her own hair.—Pl. <he>חוּטִים</he>, <cite ref="H00293"><he>חוּטִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 52a:19">Snh. 52ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>שני ח׳ של אש</he> two threads (lines) of fire.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:8">Lev. R. s. 14</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00093"><he>זְהוֹרִית</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:5">Sabb. VI, 5</cite> <he>חוטי שיער</he> bands made of hair.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:6">Ib. 6</cite> <he>בח׳ וכ׳</he> with threads … in their ears (in place of earrings).
<cite ref="Chullin 93a:7">Ḥull. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ שביד</he> the veins of the fore-foot; a. fr.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 2:13">Ib. 13</cite> <he>מן הח׳ ולפנים וכ׳</he> what is inside (East) of the line is considered as belonging to the land of Israel.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 5:14">Tosef.
